alias: Den multibutton: tall lamp long press
description: A long press (hold) on button 1 of the den's SNZB-01M multi button (owner, 2026-11-06). If the den tall lamp's colour cycle is not running it starts it (den_multibutton_tall_lamp_colour_cycle, which does the cycling). If it is running, a second long press stops it and sets the lamp to the default white, 2700 K at 75 % (owner's choice; nothing in the repo recorded a default). Whether it is running comes from the runner's `current` attribute; the lamp is set 0.5 s after the stop event so that the runner's last step cannot land after it. Button 1's other clicks are den_multibutton_tall_lamp, and they also stop the cycle. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
